evidence.excerpt: Moving beyond the evolution of isolated tasks, we propose to optimize the benchmark generation workflow itself end to end with MetaBench-Harness, a dual-loop search framework.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: While existing automated evolution frameworks attempt to generate harder questions by perturbing individual tasks, they remain constrained by rigid, hard-coded generation rules.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
